<notice>Most infrared devices use the same key code for power toggle, which may result in the device actually turning off when powerstate is set to 1. Infrared devices currently support control of only a single property.</notice>  

### Fan  
#### thing.attribute.set  
- powerstate: Toggle  
    - 0: shutdown  
    - 1: open  

### Air Conditioner  
#### thing.attribute.set  
- powerstate: Toggle  
    - 0: shutdown  
    - 1: open  
- windspeed: Wind speed  
    - 0~3: Wind speed levels 0 to 3  
- targetTemperature: Target temperature  
    - 16~30: Target temperature in degrees Celsius  
- mode: pattern  
    - 2: Automatic pattern  
    - 9: refrigeration pattern  
    - 10: Heating pattern  
    - 12: Airflow pattern  
    - 13: dehumidify pattern  
    - 14: sleep pattern  
    - 38: Turbo pattern  
    - 230: Energy-saving pattern  
    - 231: prefetch pattern  

### TV Devices (TV, set-top box, projector, set-top box)  
#### thing.attribute.set  
- powerstate: Toggle  
    - 0: shutdown  
    - 1: open  
- channelNumber: channel number  
    - 0~999: channel number  
- muteMode: Mute mode  
    - 0: Disable mute mode  
    - 1: Enable mute mode  

#### thing.attribute.adjust  
- volume: Volume  
    - 1: Increase volume by one  
    - -1: Decrease volume by one

UpdateHotelSceneItem.title: Edit hotel scenario service
UpdateHotelSceneItem.description:
- ***Impact factors:***
> 
> - `1. Whether the price equals 0;`
> - `2. Whether a template is used;`
> - `3. Adding or modifying a dialogue;`

- ***Modification rules:***
> 
> 1. **Whether the price is 0 CNY**
>     - Equals 0: `dialogueList.size = 1` and parameter content is `process = 0` (one-round dialogue, free service);
>     - Greater than 0: `dialogueList.size = 2` and parameter content includes `process = 0` (one-round dialogue, paid service, asking whether needed) + `process = 1` (two-round dialogue, response to whether needed)
> 2. **Whether a template is used**
>     - `"isUseTemplateAnswer": true/false`
> 3. **Adding or modifying a dialogue**

1. ***Adding a dialogue:***
>  - **Using a template**: `yesAnswerTemplate` && `noAnswerTemplate` && `process` are not null; all others are null;
>  - **Not using a template**: `yesAnswer` && `noAnswer` && `process` are not null; all others are null

1. ***Modifying a dialogue***

  >   - **Using a template**: `yesAnswerTemplate` && `noAnswerTemplate` && `process` && `dialogueId` && `serviceId` are not null; all others are null;
   >  - **Not using a template**: `yesAnswer` && `noAnswer` && `process` && `dialogueId` && `serviceId` are not null; all others are null
